objects.name: Analytic 2131
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process owned by an Industrial Control System (ICS) service User Identifier (UID) executing a Set User Identifier (SUID) binary or exploiting a kernel vulnerability to obtain root privileges, detected via unexpected setuid/setgid syscalls from a process not invoked via sudo. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): setuid/setgid to root from a process owned by Industrial Control Systems (ICS) service User Identifier (UID) that was not invoked via sudo

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window within which a device/process crash and subsequent privileged action are considered correlated.
Documented hash/name signatures of known vulnerable drivers exploitable for privilege escalation (BYOVD technique).
